summary: Security vulnerability CVE-2026-31812 in vendored quinn-proto 0.11.12 requires a bump to >= 0.11.14 to fix an unauthenticated remote DoS in QUIC transport parameter handling.
userImpact: Users of temporalio 1.22.0 and 1.23.0 have a high-severity CVE in their dependency that could enable DoS attacks, though actual exposure is limited since QUIC is not used.
rootCause: Panic in QUIC transport parameter handling in quinn-proto 0.11.12 that can be exploited for unauthenticated remote DoS.
proposedFix: Bump quinn-proto version to >= 0.11.14 in the vendored Cargo.lock file.
resolutionDetails: Quinn-proto dependency was bumped to >= 0.11.14 to address CVE-2026-31812.
keyQuote: The vendored Cargo.lock in the Rust bridge ships `quinn-proto 0.11.12`, which is affected by CVE-2026-31812 (unauthenticated remote DoS via panic in QUIC transport parameter handling).
